# Case 32: Conclusion restates contributions and drops the selected-run scope
Skill: write-abstracts-and-conclusions
Expected gates: G-AC-concl, G-AC-claim, G-STY-concl
Language: en
Snippet:
> Our contributions are threefold. First, we proposed a model. Second, we formulated a problem. Third, we designed an algorithm. The mobile station always reduces the total energy, which shows the practical value of this study.
Why it fails: the result section reports the energy saving only in the selected runs and only for robot energy. The Conclusion repeats the contribution list, strengthens the claim, and adds an unmeasured value judgment.
